title: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models via Low-Rank Adaptation in Resource-Constrained Environments
abstract: Fine-tuning large language models end-to-end remains prohibitively expensive for most research groups. We study LoRA-based parameter-efficient fine-tuning under tight GPU memory budgets and show that aggressive rank reduction, combined with gradient checkpointing and 8-bit optimizers, retains 97% of full fine-tuning benchmark performance at under 10% of the trainable parameter count.
